title: Regulatory KB source entry
description: Schema for an entry in manifest.json 'sources' and (loosely) for the YAML frontmatter of dataset cards in documents/ and reports/.

id.description: Stable slug used to cross-reference from cards/taxonomy.

drive_id.description: Microsoft Graph drive id of the shared KB folder.

item_id.description: Microsoft Graph item id of the file.

refresh.description: static=extracted to a card; quarterly=read live; ongoing=appended over time; encrypted=not extractable.

extractable.description: Whether Graph text extraction works (false for MIP-encrypted).

reporting_date.description: Reporting reference date (YYYY-MM-DD), for periodic reports.

priority.description: e.g. PRIMARY/SECONDARY for overlapping numeric sources.

dataset_card.description: Relative path to the extracted card, if any.
